name: Dayline
subtitle: Personal daily dashboard — tasks, bookmarks, everything synced.

versions.localizedDescription:
Dayline 1.8.7
- Share extension: App Group now discovered from the signed binary's own entitlements (works without an embedded profile, e.g. SideStore) plus team-ID rename patterns, each verified with the OS
- Share extension status now lists every candidate group with ✓/✗

Dayline 1.8.6
- Share extension hardening for SideStore/AltStore: the App Group is now OS-verified (probed from both the extension's and the app's signed profiles)
- New: gear menu > Share extension status - shows exactly which container each side resolved

Dayline 1.8.5
- Share extension now works under SideStore/AltStore: the App Group is resolved at runtime from the signed profile, so re-signers that rename the group no longer break Safari captures

Dayline 1.8.4
- To-Do first with auto-focused quick-add (pinned section)
- Move tasks between sections (drag + menu), synced ordering
- Task tags with two-way registry sync, reminders with notification actions
- Section header bands with progress, persisted collapse state
- Sync status in the gear menu, keyboard-aware bottom bar
- Optimized sync engine (payload memoization, watchdog)
